svg.title: Depthly Yearly Analytics — design proposal
svg.desc: Yearly focus view with four primary metrics, activity heatmap, monthly totals, project shares and four supporting highlights. Example values only.
svg.text: See the bigger picture of your focus.
Explore your focus patterns across the year, one day and month at a time.
Each square is a day. Brighter squares show more recorded focus time.
Select a recorded day to explore Daily view.
Compare your recorded time across the year.
November is in progress. December has not started yet.
Projects ranked by focus time this year.
Shares use the selected year and project filter.
Design proposal · illustrative year data · future dates and partial months are distinguished from completed periods.
